"""A module binding of a former root, read attribute by attribute."""

from fastapi import APIRouter
from threetears.evals import Eval, ops
from threetears.evals import shapes as evals_shapes
from threetears.evals.host import EvalServiceError
from threetears.evals.kernel import EvalServiceError

router = APIRouter()


@router.get("/runs")
def runs(host: ops.OpsHost) -> object:
    try:
        return ops.runs_list(host, evals_shapes.LaunchArguments())
    except EvalServiceError as refusal:
        return Eval, refusal


def record(host: evals_host.OpsHost, run_ids: list[str]) -> object:
    return evals_host.judge_profiles_record(host, ops.JudgeProfilesRecord(judge_run_ids=run_ids))
